description: Canonical fill of the participant guidance document. Every value is obviously synthetic. Docket/case number, OTN, judge, judge address, prosecutor position, and all protected and outside-party fields stay blank.

chargeData.chargeDescription: Arrest record for the offense charged in the diverted case
chargeData.disposition: Successful completion of superior court drug diversion under PC 1000.5

eligibilityData.eligibilityBasisLabel: Arrest sealing after successful completion of a superior court drug diversion programme under Cal. Penal Code § 851.90
eligibilityData.waitingPeriodText: After successful completion of the diversion or deferred entry of judgment programme — duration: none stated
additionalFacts: The judge may order the arrest records sealed on written or oral motion of any party, or on the court's own motion, with notice to all parties.
There is no statewide Judicial Council form; the county publishes its own petition and order.
Proof of programme completion is obtained by the participant from the court or the programme provider. LegalEase does not obtain, receive or inspect it.
